decision: Rejected: native-input changes are small and overlap sample variability; the affected owned-input screen is slightly slower. Retain the previous wrapper implementation and choose a larger algorithmic reduction.
scope: One MCU-coordinate hoist, two native-input repeats and one affected owned-input screen. Both frozen JPEGs use one existing original 513x259 raster. No new image, preparation or quality enumeration.

quietnessBefore.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

quietnessAfter.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

baseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

provenance: Frozen prepared native qscale-5 JPEG from HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8), original deterministic asymmetric RGBA8 flattened once on RGB 0x204060. 133041 bytes, common 1x2 factors (4:4:4) and variable Huffman tables. No additional source raster, upstream corpus or quality enumeration.

uncertainty: Short screens do not certify small speedups or regressions. Ratios use the faster native bracket. Conservative uppers retain managed and native sample uncertainty. Failed post-run rolling load checks and later passing cooldowns are retained. Rejected production change is discarded; actual dependency-free package from the accepted wrapper checkpoint remains unchanged.
